mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address (user_id, label, contact, phone, region, detail, longitude, latitude, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{label}, #{contact}, #{phone}, #{region}, #{detail}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{isDefault})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET label = #{label}, contact = #{contact}, phone = #{phone}, region = #{region}, detail = #{detail}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, is_default = #{isDefault}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receive_preference (user_id, time_slot, deliver_method, notify_channel, quiet_hours, no_call, fragile_care, auto_proxy, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{timeSlot}, #{deliverMethod}, #{notifyChannel}, #{quietHours}, #{noCall}, #{fragileCare}, #{autoProxy}, #{note}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET time_slot = EXCLUDED.time_slot, deliver_method = EXCLUDED.deliver_method, notify_channel = EXCLUDED.notify_channel, quiet_hours = EXCLUDED.quiet_hours, no_call = EXCLUDED.no_call, fragile_care = EXCLUDED.fragile_care, auto_proxy = EXCLUDED.auto_proxy, note = EXCLUDED.note, updated_at = now()
INSERT INTO phone_contact (user_id, name, phone, relation, is_starred, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{relation}, #{isStarred}, #{remark})
